extension.name: The Girl from Random Chatting Manga Online

quellen.name: The Girl from Random Chatting Manga Online

description.const:
If you lived through – or are still living through – high school, you can relate to Joon-Woo. An outcast and a loner, his only joy comes from the hours he spends on his phone, randomly chatting with strangers. It’s all weird and meaningless, until Joon-Woo strikes gold – as he’s matched in a private chat with a pretty young girl his age. Jackpot! But when he discovers that this same pretty girl is actually his classmate Seung Ah, things get a little too real for a guy who’s never even remotely been kissed.
(sourced from Webtoon)

genres.const: Action, Drama, Comedy, Romance, Slice of Life, Shounen, Harem

hinweise: Ein-Serien-Website (abgeschlossen): ein Eintrag, Details als feste Werte wie in der Community; Cover von der Startseite (letztes Galerie-Bild im noscript); Suche filtert lokal.

Kapitel aus der WordPress-API /wp-json/mg/v1/chapters-list (Liste an der Wurzel, Felder title/date/url); Kapitel-URL = absolute URL aus der API (Community speichert nur den letzten Pfadteil und baut /manga/<slug>). Name = Teil nach ', ' im Titel.
Seiten: img in p > noscript (setzt voraus, dass die Engine noscript-Inhalt als HTML parst wie Jsoup).
